text: I feel a sense of curiosity and intrigue here. The first scene is quiet—a conference or workshop room waits in anticipation, almost as if the walls themselves are holding their breath before an event begins. The second image hums with color and energy; the R+D space invites my mind to play with ideas about innovation and collaboration. Both spaces, though still, seem to pulse with the potential of knowledge exchanged and discoveries made. I feel open, observant, and eager to participate in the unfolding exploration of thought.
